@inline cached_force(i,j,k,grid,clock,fields,cache)=@inbounds cache[i,j,k]
native_U(m)=Tuple(Array(interior(f)) for f in m.ocean.velocities)

function build_model(cfg)
    cfg=merge(copy(DEFAULTS),cfg)
    validate_wave_sources!(cfg)
    cfg["maximum_parent_band_steepness"]>0 || error("maximum_parent_band_steepness must be positive")
    nx,ny,nz=Int(cfg["nx"]),Int(cfg["ny"]),Int(cfg["nz"])
    isodd(nx)&&isodd(ny)&&min(nx,ny)>=7&&nz>=4 || error("Odd nx/ny >=7 and nz>=4 required")
    cfg["coupling"] in ("two_way","prescribed","off") || error("Unknown coupling")
    if cfg["coupling"]=="off" && cfg["wave_momentum_exchange"] &&
       cfg["wave_source_mode"] in ("observed","wind_visc","wind_damped")
        error("Budgeted wave sources require active pseudomomentum coupling; use prescribed to suppress current-to-wave refraction")
    end
    cfg["nu_mean"]>=0 && cfg["wind_alpha"]>=0 || error("Viscosity and wind_alpha must be nonnegative")
    cfg["initial_profile"] in ("wind_drift","exponential") || error("Unknown initial profile")
    cfg["initial_velocity_convention"] in ("eulerian","lagrangian") || error("Unknown initial velocity convention")
    cfg["seed_type"] in ("smooth","gaussian") || error("Unknown seed type")
    cfg["intrinsic_model"] in ("tensor","linear") || error("Unknown intrinsic model")
    cfg["coupling_evaluation"] in ("auto","direct","fft","batched") || error("Unknown coupling evaluation")
    cfg["current_kernels"] in ("optimized","reference") || error("Unknown current kernels")
    cfg["current_advection"] in ("weno5","centered4") || error("current_advection must be weno5 or centered4")
    cfg["current_minimum_buffer_upwind_order"] isa Integer && cfg["current_minimum_buffer_upwind_order"] in (1,3) ||
        error("current_minimum_buffer_upwind_order must be 1 or 3")
    cfg["current_diffusion_order"] isa Integer && cfg["current_diffusion_order"] in (2,4) || error("current_diffusion_order must be integer 2 or 4")
    cfg["defer_final_refresh"] isa Bool || error("defer_final_refresh must be a Bool")
    cfg["checkpoint_interval"]>=0 || error("checkpoint_interval must be nonnegative; zero disables intermediate checkpoints")
    cfg["fft_threads"] isa Integer && cfg["fft_threads"]>=1 || error("fft_threads must be a positive integer")
    cfg["initial_profile"]!="wind_drift" || (cfg["initial_age"]>0 && cfg["nu_mean"]>0) || error("Wind drift requires positive initial_age and nu_mean")
    all(cfg[k]>0 for k in ("Lx","Ly","H","dt","duration","history_interval","snapshot_interval","shear_depth")) || error("Positive lengths and times required")
    cfg["z_mapping"] in ("power","exponential") || error("Unknown z mapping")
    cfg["z_stretch"]>=(cfg["z_mapping"]=="power" ? 1 : 0) || error("Invalid z_stretch")
    cfg["g"]>0 && cfg["T"]>=0 || error("g must be positive and T nonnegative")
    # Oceananigans otherwise plans its pressure transforms with 4*nthreads(),
    # oversubscribing a Slurm allocation. Wrinkle uses global FFTW defaults.
    # Set both before constructing plans; this changes evaluation, not physics.
    Oceananigans.Solvers.FFTW_NUM_THREADS[]=Int(cfg["fft_threads"])
    Wrinkle.FFTW.set_num_threads(Int(cfg["fft_threads"]))
    g=SpectralGrid(nx,ny,cfg["Lx"],cfg["Ly"];order=2,gravity=cfg["g"])
    raw=readdlm(cfg["modes_file"],'\t',Float64;skipstart=1)
    size(raw,2)==6 || error("modes.tsv must have six columns")
    mx=Int.(raw[:,1]);my=Int.(raw[:,2]);omega=raw[:,3];scale=raw[:,4]
    all(>(0),omega)&&all(>(0),scale) || error("Positive omega and canonical scale required")
    K=hypot.(2π.*mx./cfg["Lx"],2π.*my./cfg["Ly"])
    expected_omega=sqrt.(cfg["g"].*K.+cfg["T"].*K.^3)
    isapprox(omega,expected_omega;rtol=1e-11,atol=1e-12) || error("modes.tsv frequencies do not match configured g, T and domain; regenerate inputs")
    isapprox(scale,sqrt.(2 .*omega./K);rtol=1e-11,atol=1e-12) || error("modes.tsv canonical scales are inconsistent; regenerate inputs")
    all(abs.(mx).<=nx÷2)&&all(abs.(my).<=ny÷2) || error("Retained modes exceed spectral grid")
    locations=[CartesianIndex(mod(mx[j],nx)+1,mod(my[j],ny)+1) for j in eachindex(mx)]
    length(unique(locations))==length(locations) || error("Duplicate parent modes")
    all((mx.!=0).|(my.!=0)) || error("Zero wave mode not supported")
    active=falses(nx,ny);active[locations].=true
    zf=vertical_faces(cfg,nz)
    # Keep the original FFT operators available as an independent reference.
    evaluation = cfg["coupling_evaluation"] == "batched" ? :fft : Symbol(cfg["coupling_evaluation"])
    c=StaggeredCoupler(g,zf;active_modes=active,kernel=:polarized,evaluation=evaluation)
    fast_workspace = cfg["coupling_evaluation"] == "batched" ? FastCouplingWorkspace(g,c.layers) : nothing
    diffusive_number(cfg,c.layers)<.5 || error("Explicit viscous number exceeds .5; reduce dt")
    reference_projection=ProjectionCache(c,nx,ny)
    projection=cfg["current_kernels"]=="optimized" ? TypedProjectionWorkspace(reference_projection) : reference_projection
    vortex_workspace=cfg["current_kernels"]=="optimized" ? BatchedVortexWorkspace(g,c) : nothing
    phase=exp.(im.*(π.*mx./nx.+π.*my./ny))
    b=zeros(ComplexF64,nx,ny);b[locations]=scale.*complex.(raw[:,5],raw[:,6]).*phase
    if cfg["wave_source_mode"]=="observed"
        target,_=observed_slope_and_rate(cfg,cfg["initial_age"])
        s=sqrt(2sum(K.^3 ./omega.*abs2.(b[locations])))
        s>0 || error("Observed-wave control requires a nonzero initial carrier")
        b.*=target/s
    end
    tensor=TensorTerm[]
    if cfg["intrinsic_model"]=="tensor"
        traw=readdlm(cfg["tensor_file"],'\t',Float64;skipstart=1)
        size(traw,2)==6 || error("tensor.tsv must have six columns")
        for row in eachrow(traw)
            o,i,j,l=Int.(row[1:4]).+1
            all(1 .<= [o,i,j,l] .<= length(mx)) || error("Tensor index out of bounds")
            (mx[o]==mx[i]+mx[j]-mx[l] && my[o]==my[i]+my[j]-my[l]) || error("Tensor does not conserve horizontal wavenumber")
            coef=complex(row[5],row[6])*scale[o]/(scale[i]*scale[j]*scale[l])
            push!(tensor,TensorTerm(o,i,j,l,coef))
        end
    end
    dims=(nx,ny,nz);forcing=(zeros(dims),zeros(dims),zeros(nx,ny,nz+1))
    fs=(u=Forcing(cached_force;discrete_form=true,parameters=forcing[1]),
        v=Forcing(cached_force;discrete_form=true,parameters=forcing[2]),
        w=Forcing(cached_force;discrete_form=true,parameters=forcing[3]))
    og=RectilinearGrid(CPU(),Float64;size=dims,halo=(3,3,3),x=(0,g.Lx),y=(0,g.Ly),z=zf,
                       topology=(Periodic,Periodic,Bounded))
    # Keep upwind reconstruction through the nearest-boundary cells when the
    # minimum order is 1. The native default (3) switches to centered order 2
    # where the WENO stencil does not fit; that can undershoot a surface dye
    # layer. This selects existing conservative fluxes, with no dye clipping.
    advection=cfg["current_advection"]=="centered4" ? Centered(order=4) :
        WENO(order=5,minimum_buffer_upwind_order=cfg["current_minimum_buffer_upwind_order"])
    advection=dye_advection(cfg,advection)
    ocean=NonhydrostaticModel(og;advection=advection,timestepper=:RungeKutta3,
        forcing=fs,stokes_drift=nothing,dye_model_kwargs(cfg)...)
    # Initialization diagnostics are saved in configuration.toml for inspection,
    # but must not change the scientific signature when that file is reused.
    diagnostic_keys=("initial_advective_cfl","initial_vertical_cfl","initial_diffusive_number",
        "initial_surface_UL_mean","initial_surface_UE_mean","dye_initial_mass_per_area","dye_initial_cells_per_width")
    # Keep current_advection/current_diffusion_order in the scientific signature:
    # restarting with different current operators is a different experiment.
    spec=Dict(k=>v for (k,v) in cfg if !(k in ("output_dir","duration","resume_file","config_file","checkpoint_interval")) &&
        !(k in diagnostic_keys) && !endswith(k,"_after_projection"))
    spec["modes_sha256"]=bytes2hex(sha256(read(cfg["modes_file"])))
    spec["tensor_sha256"]=cfg["intrinsic_model"]=="tensor" ? bytes2hex(sha256(read(cfg["tensor_file"]))) : "unused_linear_intrinsic"
    spec["driver_sha256"]=bytes2hex(sha256(read(@__FILE__)))
    spec["fast_coupling_sha256"]=bytes2hex(sha256(read(joinpath(@__DIR__,"FastLayeredCoupling.jl"))))
    spec["fast_current_sha256"]=bytes2hex(sha256(read(joinpath(@__DIR__,"FastCurrentKernels.jl"))))
    spec["wave_sources_sha256"]=bytes2hex(sha256(read(joinpath(@__DIR__,"WaveSources.jl"))))
    spec["passive_dye_sha256"]=bytes2hex(sha256(read(joinpath(@__DIR__,"PassiveDye.jl"))))
    spec["conservative_dye_weno_sha256"]=bytes2hex(sha256(read(joinpath(@__DIR__,"ConservativeDyeWENO.jl"))))
    isempty(cfg["observed_steepness_file"]) || (spec["observed_steepness_sha256"]=bytes2hex(sha256(read(cfg["observed_steepness_file"]))))
    spec["physics_version"]=PHYSICS_VERSION
    io=IOBuffer();TOML.print(io,spec;sorted=true)
    signature=bytes2hex(sha256(take!(io)))
    m=Model(cfg,g,c,ocean,projection,fast_workspace,vortex_workspace,false,locations,mx,my,omega,scale,phase,tensor,b,zero(b),forcing,signature)
    initialize_current!(m)
    initialize_dye!(m)
    refresh_state!(m)
    return m
end

function pseudomomentum(m)
    dims=(m.grid.nx,m.grid.ny,length(m.coupling.layers.dz))
    if m.config["coupling"]=="off"
        return (zeros(dims),zeros(dims),zeros(dims)),(zeros(dims),zeros(dims),zeros(dims[1],dims[2],dims[3]+1))
    end
    p=m.fast_workspace === nothing ? layered_pseudomomentum(m.grid,m.coupling.layers,m.b) :
        fast_pseudomomentum!(m.fast_workspace,m.grid,m.coupling.layers,m.b)
    pn=scatter_force(m.coupling,p[1],p[2],zeros(size(p[1])))
    return p,cached_project(m.projection,pn...)
end

function initialize_current!(m)
    g=m.grid;q=m.coupling.layers;cfg=m.config
    rng=Xoshiro(Int(cfg["seed"]));φ=2π.*rand(rng,6)
    ε=cfg["seed_velocity"];S=cfg["shear_velocity"];D=cfg["shear_depth"];H=cfg["H"]
    base(z)=cfg["initial_profile"]=="wind_drift" ?
        laminar_velocity(z,cfg["initial_age"],cfg["nu_mean"],cfg["wind_alpha"]) : S*exp(z/D)
    if cfg["seed_type"]=="gaussian"
        nx,ny,nz=g.nx,g.ny,length(q.dz)
        noise=cached_project(m.projection,randn(rng,nx,ny,nz),randn(rng,nx,ny,nz),randn(rng,nx,ny,nz+1))
        # Remove only constant horizontal means, preserving native divergence.
        noise[1].-=sum(q.dz[k]*mean(view(noise[1],:,:,k)) for k in 1:nz)/H
        noise[2].-=sum(q.dz[k]*mean(view(noise[2],:,:,k)) for k in 1:nz)/H
        rms=sqrt(Wrinkle.staggered_inner(m.coupling,noise,noise)/(3H))
        factor=ε/rms
        for a in noise;a.*=factor;end
        cfg["seed_rms_after_projection"]=sqrt(Wrinkle.staggered_inner(m.coupling,noise,noise)/(3H))
        cfg["seed_u_rms_after_projection"]=sqrt(sum(q.dz[k]*mean(abs2,view(noise[1],:,:,k)) for k in 1:nz)/H)
        cfg["seed_v_rms_after_projection"]=sqrt(sum(q.dz[k]*mean(abs2,view(noise[2],:,:,k)) for k in 1:nz)/H)
        cfg["seed_w_rms_after_projection"]=sqrt(sum(q.dual_dz[k]*mean(abs2,view(noise[3],:,:,k)) for k in 2:nz)/H)
        set!(m.ocean;u=noise[1].+reshape(base.(q.zcenters),1,1,nz),v=noise[2],w=noise[3])
    else
        fu(x,y,z)=base(z)+ε*(sin(2π*x/g.Lx+φ[1])*cos(2π*y/g.Ly+φ[2])+0.5cos(4π*y/g.Ly+φ[3]))*sin(π*(z+H)/H)
        fv(x,y,z)=ε*(cos(2π*x/g.Lx+φ[2])*sin(2π*y/g.Ly+φ[3])+0.4sin(4π*x/g.Lx+φ[4]))*sin(π*(z+H)/H)
        fw(x,y,z)=ε*sin(2π*x/g.Lx+φ[5])*sin(2π*y/g.Ly+φ[6])*sin(π*(z+H)/H)
        set!(m.ocean;u=fu,v=fv,w=fw)
    end
    initialized=cached_project(m.projection,native_U(m)...)
    _,Pp=pseudomomentum(m)
    UL=cfg["initial_velocity_convention"]=="eulerian" ? map(+,initialized,Pp) : initialized
    set!(m.ocean;u=UL[1],v=UL[2],w=UL[3])
    cfg["initial_advective_cfl"]=advective_cfl(m,UL,cfg["dt"])
    cfg["initial_vertical_cfl"]=cfg["dt"]*maximum(
        max(maximum(abs,view(UL[3],:,:,k)),maximum(abs,view(UL[3],:,:,k+1)))/q.dz[k]
        for k in eachindex(q.dz))
    cfg["initial_diffusive_number"]=diffusive_number(cfg,q)
    cfg["initial_surface_UL_mean"]=mean(view(UL[1],:,:,length(q.dz)))
    cfg["initial_surface_UE_mean"]=mean(view(UL[1]-Pp[1],:,:,length(q.dz)))
    refresh_state!(m)
    return m
end

function intrinsic_rate(m)
    db=zeros(ComplexF64,size(m.b));bv=m.b[m.locations]
    db[m.locations]=-im.*m.omega.*bv
    if !(m.config["wave_source_mode"] in ("fixed","observed"))
        for term in m.tensor
            db[m.locations[term.out]]+=term.coefficient*bv[term.i]*bv[term.j]*conj(bv[term.l])
        end
    end
    return db
end

function rates!(m)
    m.state_fresh=false
    db=intrinsic_rate(m)
    source_db,_=source_state(m)
    U=native_U(m)
    if m.config["coupling"]=="off"
        db.+=source_db
        foreach(a->fill!(a,0),m.forcing)
        add_eulerian_viscosity!(m.forcing,U,m.coupling.layers,m.grid.Lx/m.grid.nx,m.grid.Ly/m.grid.ny,
            m.config["nu_mean"],wind_stress(m.config,m.ocean.clock.time),m.config["current_diffusion_order"])
        return db
    end
    p,Pp=pseudomomentum(m);UE=map(-,U,Pp)
    if m.config["coupling"]=="two_way" && !(m.config["wave_source_mode"] in ("fixed","observed"))
        uc,vc,_=gather_velocity(m.coupling,UE...)
        doppler=m.fast_workspace === nothing ? layered_doppler(m.grid,m.coupling.layers,m.b,uc,vc) :
            fast_doppler!(m.fast_workspace,m.grid,m.coupling.layers,m.b,uc,vc)
        db.-=im.*doppler
    end
    # Sources are part of db BEFORE differentiating wave pseudomomentum. This
    # preserves the UL=UE+Pp variable conversion and complete history A_t.
    db.+=source_db
    # prescribed still evolves the intrinsic waves and their p_t. It suppresses
    # only current-to-wave feedback; it does not freeze the parent surface.
    pt=m.fast_workspace === nothing ? layered_pseudomomentum_tendency(m.grid,m.coupling.layers,m.b,db) :
        fast_pseudomomentum_tendency!(m.fast_workspace,m.grid,m.coupling.layers,m.b,db)
    ptn=scatter_force(m.coupling,pt[1],pt[2],zeros(size(pt[1])))
    vf=m.vortex_workspace === nothing ? Wrinkle._staggered_vortex_force(m.grid,m.coupling,p,U) :
        fast_vortex_force!(m.vortex_workspace,p,U)
    for d in 1:3;m.forcing[d].=ptn[d]+vf[d];end
    if m.config["wave_momentum_exchange"] && any(!iszero,source_db)
        # A separate physical current source closes the imposed TOTAL momentum
        # budget. Wind wave growth takes momentum from the applied stress;
        # wave loss returns it to UE. Choose the horizontal-mean wave-depth
        # distribution (exact discrete source-only p_t), without imposing wave
        # beat-scale turbulence or inventing a TKE conversion efficiency.
        ps=m.fast_workspace === nothing ? layered_pseudomomentum_tendency(m.grid,m.coupling.layers,m.b,source_db) :
            fast_pseudomomentum_tendency!(m.fast_workspace,m.grid,m.coupling.layers,m.b,source_db)
        mx=repeat(mean(ps[1];dims=(1,2)),m.grid.nx,m.grid.ny,1)
        my=repeat(mean(ps[2];dims=(1,2)),m.grid.nx,m.grid.ny,1)
        deposition=scatter_force(m.coupling,mx,my,zeros(size(mx)))
        for d in 1:3;m.forcing[d].-=deposition[d];end
    end
    add_eulerian_viscosity!(m.forcing,UE,m.coupling.layers,m.grid.Lx/m.grid.nx,m.grid.Ly/m.grid.ny,
        m.config["nu_mean"],wind_stress(m.config,m.ocean.clock.time),m.config["current_diffusion_order"])
    return db
end

"""Refresh wave forcing and native Oceananigans diagnostic state at the current time.

The default coupled_step! does this before returning. A caller explicitly using
defer_final_refresh=true may read prognostic b/velocity interiors immediately,
but must call this before inspecting forcing, pressure/tendencies or halos.
Histories, mean_fields, snapshots and checkpoint operations refresh themselves.
"""
function refresh_state!(m)
    db=rates!(m)
    update_state!(m.ocean)
    m.state_fresh=true
    return db
end

ensure_fresh!(m)=m.state_fresh ? nothing : refresh_state!(m)

function coupled_step!(m,dt)
    dt>0&&isfinite(dt) || error("Finite positive dt required")
    t0=m.ocean.clock.time;ts=m.ocean.timestepper
    γ=(ts.γ¹,ts.γ²,ts.γ³);ζ=(0.,ts.ζ²,ts.ζ³)
    for stage in 1:3
        db=rates!(m)
        update_state!(m.ocean)
        rk3_substep!(m.ocean,dt,γ[stage],stage==1 ? nothing : ζ[stage],[])
        if stage==1;m.b.+=dt*γ[stage].*db
        else;m.b.+=dt.*(γ[stage].*db+ζ[stage].*m.previous_db);end
        m.previous_db.=db
        cache_previous_tendencies!(m.ocean)
        dts=dt*(γ[stage]+ζ[stage])
        stage<3 ? tick_stage!(m.ocean.clock,dts) : tick_stage!(m.ocean.clock,t0+dt-m.ocean.clock.time,dt)
        step_closure_prognostics!(m.ocean,dts)
    end
    m.state_fresh=false
    m.config["defer_final_refresh"] || refresh_state!(m)
    return m
end

function history_values(m)
    t=m.ocean.clock.time;bv=m.b[m.locations]
    intrinsic=intrinsic_rate(m)[m.locations];full=refresh_state!(m)[m.locations]
    phase=exp.(im.*m.omega.*t)./m.origin_phase./m.scale
    A=phase.*bv
    intrinsicAt=phase.*(intrinsic.+im.*m.omega.*bv)
    fullAt=phase.*(full.+im.*m.omega.*bv)
    return A,intrinsicAt,fullAt
end

function mean_fields(m)
    ensure_fresh!(m)
    U=native_U(m);_,Pp=pseudomomentum(m)
    UE=map(-,U,Pp)
    return U,UE,gather_velocity(m.coupling,UE...)
end

function save_checkpoint(m,path)
    ensure_fresh!(m)
    state=(signature=m.signature,b=copy(m.b),U=native_U(m),time=m.ocean.clock.time,
           iteration=m.ocean.clock.iteration,dye=checkpoint_dye(m),julia_version=string(VERSION),physics_version=PHYSICS_VERSION)
    open(path*".tmp","w") do io;serialize(io,state);end
    mv(path*".tmp",path;force=true)
end
function restore_checkpoint!(m,path)
    s=open(deserialize,path)
    s.signature==m.signature || error("Checkpoint scientific signature mismatch")
    s.physics_version==PHYSICS_VERSION || error("Checkpoint physics version mismatch")
    m.b.=s.b;set!(m.ocean;u=s.U[1],v=s.U[2],w=s.U[3])
    restore_dye!(m,s.dye)
    m.ocean.clock.time=s.time;m.ocean.clock.iteration=s.iteration
    fill!(m.previous_db,0);m.state_fresh=false;refresh_state!(m)
    return m
end

function write_toml(path,data)
    open(path*".tmp","w") do io;TOML.print(io,data;sorted=true);end
    mv(path*".tmp",path;force=true)
end

function write_snapshot(m,out,index)
    U,UE,_=mean_fields(m);stem=@sprintf("frame_%06d",index)
    arrays=Dict{String,Any}()
    for (tag,vel) in (("UL",U),("UE",UE)),d in 1:3
        name=tag*"_"*("u","v","w")[d];file=stem*"_"*name*".bin"
        open(joinpath(out,file),"w") do io;write(io,Float32.(vel[d]));end
        arrays[name]=Dict("file"=>file,"shape"=>collect(size(vel[d])),"dtype"=>"float32","order"=>"F")
    end
    if m.config["dye_enabled"]
        dye=checkpoint_dye(m);file=stem*"_dye.bin"
        open(joinpath(out,file),"w") do io;write(io,Float32.(dye));end
        arrays["dye"]=Dict("file"=>file,"shape"=>collect(size(dye)),"dtype"=>"float32","order"=>"F")
    end
    write_toml(joinpath(out,stem*".toml"),Dict("time"=>m.ocean.clock.time,"iteration"=>m.ocean.clock.iteration,"arrays"=>arrays))
end

function run_tank(config_path)
    cfg=load_config(config_path);out=cfg["output_dir"]
    existing=isdir(out) ? readdir(out) : String[]
    all(name->name in ("pipeline_status.json","pipeline_status.json.tmp","source.json","tank.log"),existing) ||
        error("Output directory contains scientific data; choose a fresh output_dir (including for resume)")
    m=build_model(cfg);cfg=m.config
    isempty(cfg["resume_file"]) || restore_checkpoint!(m,cfg["resume_file"])
    stop=cfg["duration"];stop>m.ocean.clock.time || error("duration must exceed start time")
    mkpath(out);mkpath(joinpath(out,"snapshots"))
    write_toml(joinpath(out,"configuration.toml"),cfg)
    q=m.coupling.layers
    write_toml(joinpath(out,"grid.toml"),Dict("nx"=>m.grid.nx,"ny"=>m.grid.ny,"nz"=>length(q.dz),
        "Lx"=>m.grid.Lx,"Ly"=>m.grid.Ly,"H"=>cfg["H"],"z_faces"=>q.zfaces,"z_centers"=>q.zcenters,
        "x_centers"=>[(i-.5)*m.grid.Lx/m.grid.nx for i in 1:m.grid.nx],
        "y_centers"=>[(j-.5)*m.grid.Ly/m.grid.ny for j in 1:m.grid.ny],
        "velocity_convention"=>"UL prognostic; UE=UL-Pp","byte_order"=>Base.ENDIAN_BOM==0x04030201 ? "little" : "big"))
    hio=open(joinpath(out,"parent.csv"),"w");sio=open(joinpath(out,"surface_mean.bin"),"w")
    mio=open(joinpath(out,"mean_history.csv"),"w")
    println(mio,"time_s,physical_age_s,surface_UL_mean_m_s,surface_UE_mean_m_s,surface_UE_v_rms_m_s,surface_UL_crosswind_range_m_s,upper_5mm_UE_crossflow_rms_m_s,parent_transverse_action_fraction,parent_transverse_boundary_action_fraction,parent_streamwise_boundary_action_fraction")
    upper_weights=[max(0.,q.zfaces[k+1]-max(q.zfaces[k],-.005)) for k in eachindex(q.dz)]
    upper_indices=findall(>(0),upper_weights);upper_depth=sum(upper_weights)
    n=length(m.locations);headers=["t"]
    for label in ("ReA","ImA","ReIntrinsicAt","ImIntrinsicAt","ReFullAt","ImFullAt"),j in 1:n
        push!(headers,label*"_"*string(j))
    end
    println(hio,join(headers,','))
    times=Float64[];snapshot_times=Float64[];start=m.ocean.clock.time;wall=time()
    warned_band_edge=Ref(false)
    reached_validity_limit=Ref(false)
    function save_history!()
        A,I,F=history_values(m);U,UE,UC=mean_fields(m)
        vals=vcat(m.ocean.clock.time,real(A),imag(A),real(I),imag(I),real(F),imag(F))
        println(hio,join((@sprintf("%.17g",v) for v in vals),','));flush(hio)
        write(sio,cat(Float32.(UC[1][:,:,end]),Float32.(UC[2][:,:,end]);dims=3));flush(sio)
        push!(times,m.ocean.clock.time)
        div=maximum(abs,staggered_divergence(m.coupling,U...))
        all(isfinite,m.b)&&all(a->all(isfinite,a),U) || error("Nonfinite state")
        div<1e-7 || error("Native divergence exceeds tolerance: $div")
        cfl=advective_cfl(m,U,cfg["dt"])
        cfl<.5 || error("Mean CFL exceeded .5; reduce dt and restart from validated state")
        action=abs2.(m.b[m.locations]);totalaction=max(sum(action),eps())
        transverse_edge=sum(action[abs.(m.my).==maximum(abs,m.my)])/totalaction
        streamwise_edge=sum(action[(m.mx.==minimum(m.mx)).|(m.mx.==maximum(m.mx))])/totalaction
        # A single retained mode is necessarily at both boundaries; do not warn
        # about that prescribed-wave control. Retained-band runs are flagged.
        at_edge=length(unique(m.my))>1 && transverse_edge>.05 ||
                length(unique(m.mx))>1 && streamwise_edge>.05
        if at_edge && !warned_band_edge[]
            @warn "More than 5% of parent action is on a retained-band boundary; inspect truncation before interpreting this run" time=m.ocean.clock.time transverse_edge streamwise_edge
            warned_band_edge[]=true
        end
        surface_u=UC[1][:,:,end];surface_v=UC[2][:,:,end]
        ul_surface_u=U[1][:,:,end]
        ulmean=mean(ul_surface_u);uemean=mean(surface_u);vrms=sqrt(mean(abs2,surface_v))
        crosswind_range=maximum(mean(ul_surface_u;dims=1))-minimum(mean(ul_surface_u;dims=1))
        crossflow_rms=sqrt(sum(upper_weights[k]*(mean(abs2,view(UC[2],:,:,k))+
            mean(abs2,view(UC[3],:,:,k))) for k in upper_indices)/upper_depth)
        transverse_action=sum(action[m.my.!=0])/totalaction
        meanvals=(m.ocean.clock.time,cfg["initial_age"]+m.ocean.clock.time,ulmean,uemean,vrms,
            crosswind_range,crossflow_rms,transverse_action,transverse_edge,streamwise_edge)
        println(mio,join((@sprintf("%.17g",v) for v in meanvals),','));flush(mio)
        source_diagnostics=record_wave_sources!(m,out)
        record_dye!(m,out)
        reached_validity_limit[]=cfg["wave_source_mode"]!="none" && source_diagnostics["parent_characteristic_steepness"]>=cfg["maximum_parent_band_steepness"]
        write_toml(joinpath(out,"status.toml"),Dict("time"=>m.ocean.clock.time,"iteration"=>m.ocean.clock.iteration,
            "max_divergence"=>div,"mean_cfl"=>cfl,"viscous_number"=>diffusive_number(cfg,q),
            "absolute_wind_age"=>cfg["initial_age"]+m.ocean.clock.time,
            "kinematic_wind_stress"=>wind_stress(cfg,m.ocean.clock.time),
            "parent_action"=>sum(action),
            "transverse_action_fraction"=>transverse_action,
            "transverse_boundary_action_fraction"=>transverse_edge,
            "streamwise_boundary_action_fraction"=>streamwise_edge,"parent_band_edge_warning"=>warned_band_edge[],
            "surface_UE_u_mean"=>uemean,"surface_UE_u_std"=>std(surface_u;corrected=false),
            "surface_UE_v_rms"=>vrms,"upper_5mm_UE_crossflow_rms"=>crossflow_rms,
            "surface_UL_u_mean"=>ulmean,"surface_UL_u_std"=>std(ul_surface_u;corrected=false),
            "surface_UL_u_crosswind_range"=>crosswind_range,
            "parent_characteristic_steepness"=>source_diagnostics["parent_characteristic_steepness"],
            "termination_reason"=>reached_validity_limit[] ? "validity_limit" : "running",
            "wall_seconds"=>time()-wall,"history_records"=>length(times)))
    end
    try
        save_history!();write_snapshot(m,joinpath(out,"snapshots"),0);push!(snapshot_times,start)
        cfg["checkpoint_interval"]>0 && save_checkpoint(m,joinpath(out,"checkpoint.jls"))
        nexth=start+cfg["history_interval"];nexts=start+cfg["snapshot_interval"]
        next_checkpoint=cfg["checkpoint_interval"]>0 ? start+cfg["checkpoint_interval"] : Inf
        while m.ocean.clock.time<stop-1e-12 && !reached_validity_limit[]
            dt=min(cfg["dt"],stop-m.ocean.clock.time,nexth-m.ocean.clock.time,nexts-m.ocean.clock.time)
            dt>1e-14 || error("Output scheduling produced zero step")
            coupled_step!(m,dt);t=m.ocean.clock.time
            # Stop at the stated weak-wave validity bound, never clamp waves.
            # This is an informative control outcome, not a completed 14 s run.
            if cfg["wave_source_mode"]!="none" && source_state(m)[2].steepness>=cfg["maximum_parent_band_steepness"]
                save_history!()
                write_snapshot(m,joinpath(out,"snapshots"),length(snapshot_times));push!(snapshot_times,t)
                @warn "Parent-wave validity limit reached; preserving final state and stopping this case" time=t steepness=source_state(m)[2].steepness
                break
            end
            if t>=nexth-1e-12 || t>=stop-1e-12
                save_history!();nexth+=cfg["history_interval"]
            end
            if t>=nexts-1e-12 || t>=stop-1e-12
                write_snapshot(m,joinpath(out,"snapshots"),length(snapshot_times));push!(snapshot_times,t)
                nexts+=cfg["snapshot_interval"]
                if t>=next_checkpoint-1e-12
                    save_checkpoint(m,joinpath(out,"checkpoint.jls"))
                    next_checkpoint=t+cfg["checkpoint_interval"]
                end
                @printf("t=%.5f / %.5f s, step=%d, wall=%.1f s\n",t,stop,m.ocean.clock.iteration,time()-wall);flush(stdout)
            end
        end
        save_checkpoint(m,joinpath(out,"checkpoint.jls"))
        write_toml(joinpath(out,"metadata.toml"),Dict("complete"=>!reached_validity_limit[],
            "termination_reason"=>reached_validity_limit[] ? "validity_limit" : "completed",
            "requested_duration_s"=>stop,"actual_final_time_s"=>m.ocean.clock.time,
            "history_count"=>length(times),"times"=>times,
            "snapshot_times"=>snapshot_times,"nx"=>m.grid.nx,"ny"=>m.grid.ny,"nmodes"=>n,
            "surface_mean_shape"=>[m.grid.nx,m.grid.ny,2],"surface_mean_order"=>"F","surface_mean_dtype"=>"float32",
            "surface_mean_z"=>q.zcenters[end],"surface_mean_convention"=>"center-gathered UE=UL-Pp at highest center",
            "mean_history_file"=>"mean_history.csv",
            "mean_history_crossflow_convention"=>"sqrt(depth-average horizontal-mean(UE_v^2+UE_w^2)) in upper 5 mm; center-gathered UE with exact partial-cell depth weights",
            "parent_A_phase_origin"=>"laboratory x=y=0","coupling"=>cfg["coupling"],"signature"=>m.signature,
            "wall_seconds"=>time()-wall,"julia_version"=>string(VERSION),"oceananigans_version"=>string(pkgversion(Oceananigans)),
            "closure"=>cfg["current_advection"]*" advection plus explicit molecular nu*Delta(UE); horizontal diffusion order="*
                string(cfg["current_diffusion_order"])*", vertical diffusion order=2; rigid impermeable boundaries",
            "current_advection"=>cfg["current_advection"],"current_diffusion_order"=>cfg["current_diffusion_order"],
            "current_minimum_buffer_upwind_order"=>cfg["current_minimum_buffer_upwind_order"],
            "advection_boundary_fallback"=>cfg["current_advection"]=="weno5" ?
                (cfg["current_minimum_buffer_upwind_order"]==1 ? "upwind-biased order 1; shared velocity/tracer advection" :
                 "centered order 2 below minimum WENO order 3; shared velocity/tracer advection") : "native centered order reduction",
            "wind_stress_convention"=>"nu*d_z UE_u=tau at top, zero viscous flux for UE_v; homogeneous lower stress; physical Eulerian stress",
            "initial_velocity_convention"=>cfg["initial_velocity_convention"],
            "initial_wind_age"=>cfg["initial_age"],"final_wind_age"=>cfg["initial_age"]+m.ocean.clock.time,
            "intrinsic_model"=>cfg["intrinsic_model"],"coupling_evaluation"=>cfg["coupling_evaluation"],
            "fft_threads"=>cfg["fft_threads"],
            "current_kernels"=>cfg["current_kernels"],"defer_final_refresh"=>cfg["defer_final_refresh"],
            "wave_source_mode"=>cfg["wave_source_mode"],"wave_momentum_exchange"=>cfg["wave_momentum_exchange"],
            "wave_momentum_exchange_profile"=>"negative horizontal mean of exact source-only wave pseudomomentum tendency at each depth; no added TKE",
            "wind_input_stress_cap"=>"wave-input momentum vector magnitude cannot exceed supplied total stress; common parameter-free rate multiplier",
            "wave_energy_diagnostic"=>"quadratic E2/rho=sum omega*abs2(b); excludes cubic-interaction Hamiltonian contribution",
            "parent_steepness_definition"=>"sqrt(2sum k^3/omega*abs2(b)) = sqrt(2<|grad eta_parent_linear|^2>)",
            "prescribed_wave_controls"=>"fixed/observed use linear intrinsic phases only; observed logarithmic slope interpolation; prescribed change is an effective external source, not identified wind or dissipation",
            "dye_enabled"=>cfg["dye_enabled"],"dye_advection"=>cfg["dye_advection"],
            "cho_feedback"=>false,"wave_kernel"=>"Wrinkle polarized quadratic reciprocal closure on retained free modes"))
    finally
        close(hio);close(sio);close(mio)
    end
    return m
end

"""Passive, wave-averaged dye transported by the native Lagrangian velocity.

The fixed physical initial width is represented by exact cell averages of a
surface-centred Gaussian. Unit mass per horizontal area is preserved across
grids; no concentration clipping or renormalization occurs during evolution.
"""

dye_enabled(cfg)=get(cfg,"dye_enabled",false)

include("ConservativeDyeWENO.jl")

function dye_model_kwargs(cfg)
    dye_enabled(cfg) || return NamedTuple()
    κ=get(cfg,"dye_diffusivity",1e-7)
    δ=get(cfg,"dye_initial_width",5e-4)
    isfinite(κ)&&κ>=0 || error("dye_diffusivity must be finite and nonnegative")
    isfinite(δ)&&δ>0 || error("dye_initial_width must be finite and positive")
    return (tracers=:dye,
        closure=ScalarDiffusivity(ν=0.,κ=(dye=Float64(κ),)),
        boundary_conditions=(dye=FieldBoundaryConditions(
            top=FluxBoundaryCondition(0.),bottom=FluxBoundaryCondition(0.)),))
end

@inline dye_erf(x::Float64)=ccall((:erf,Base.Math.libm),Float64,(Float64,),x)

function dye_initial_profile(zfaces,δ)
    length(zfaces)>=2 && all(diff(zfaces).>0) || error("Increasing dye cell faces required")
    isfinite(δ)&&δ>0 || error("Positive finite dye initial width required")
    isapprox(last(zfaces),0.;atol=1e-12) || error("Dye surface must be at z=0")
    dz=diff(zfaces)
    # Integral of exp[-(z/δ)^2] in each cell; finite-depth normalization.
    masses=[dye_erf(Float64(zfaces[k+1]/δ))-dye_erf(Float64(zfaces[k]/δ))
            for k in eachindex(dz)]
    normalization=sum(masses)
    normalization>0 || error("Initial dye profile has zero mass")
    return masses./(normalization.*dz)
end

function initialize_dye!(m)
    dye_enabled(m.config) || return m
    profile=dye_initial_profile(m.coupling.layers.zfaces,m.config["dye_initial_width"])
    nx,ny=m.grid.nx,m.grid.ny
    concentration=repeat(reshape(profile,1,1,length(profile)),nx,ny,1)
    set!(m.ocean;dye=concentration)
    m.config["dye_initial_mass_per_area"]=sum(profile.*m.coupling.layers.dz)
    m.config["dye_initial_cells_per_width"]=m.config["dye_initial_width"]/m.coupling.layers.dz[end]
    return m
end

"""Return mass and depths from a bottom-to-top cell-average profile.

Centroid uses signed concentration. The quantile uses the positive part of the
horizontally averaged profile; the independent three-dimensional negative-mass
diagnostic prevents sizeable undershoots from being silently accepted.
"""
function dye_profile_diagnostics(profile,zfaces;fraction=.99)
    length(profile)+1==length(zfaces) || error("Dye profile/grid size mismatch")
    0<fraction<1 || error("Dye quantile must lie between zero and one")
    all(isfinite,profile)&&all(isfinite,zfaces) || error("Nonfinite dye profile")
    dz=diff(zfaces);all(dz.>0) || error("Increasing dye cell faces required")
    centers=(zfaces[1:end-1].+zfaces[2:end])./2
    mass=sum(profile.*dz)
    mass>0 || error("Nonpositive dye mass")
    centroid=-sum(profile.*dz.*centers)/mass
    positive=max.(profile,0.)
    positive_mass=sum(positive.*dz)
    target=fraction*positive_mass
    accumulated=0.;depth=NaN
    for k in reverse(eachindex(profile))
        cellmass=positive[k]*dz[k]
        if accumulated+cellmass>=target && positive[k]>0
            depth=-zfaces[k+1]+(target-accumulated)/positive[k]
            break
        end
        accumulated+=cellmass
    end
    isfinite(depth) || error("Dye quantile could not be located")
    return (mass_per_area=mass,centroid_depth_m=centroid,z99_depth_m=depth)
end

function dye_diagnostics(m)
    dye_enabled(m.config) || return nothing
    c=Array(interior(m.ocean.tracers.dye))
    all(isfinite,c) || error("Nonfinite passive dye")
    q=m.coupling.layers
    profile=vec(mean(c;dims=(1,2)))
    base=dye_profile_diagnostics(profile,q.zfaces)
    negative=sum(q.dz[k]*mean(max.(-view(c,:,:,k),0.)) for k in eachindex(q.dz))
    positive=sum(q.dz[k]*mean(max.(view(c,:,:,k),0.)) for k in eachindex(q.dz))
    return merge(base,(negative_mass_fraction=negative/max(positive,eps()),
        min_concentration=minimum(c),max_concentration=maximum(c),profile=profile))
end

function checkpoint_dye(m)
    return dye_enabled(m.config) ? Array(interior(m.ocean.tracers.dye)) : nothing
end

function restore_dye!(m,state)
    if dye_enabled(m.config)
        state===nothing && error("Dye-enabled checkpoint is missing its tracer")
        size(state)==size(interior(m.ocean.tracers.dye)) || error("Checkpoint dye size mismatch")
        set!(m.ocean;dye=state)
    elseif state!==nothing
        error("Cannot restore dye into a dye-disabled model")
    end
    return m
end

function record_dye!(m,out)
    dye_enabled(m.config) || return nothing
    d=dye_diagnostics(m);q=m.coupling.layers;t=m.ocean.clock.time
    target=get(m.config,"dye_initial_mass_per_area",1.)
    mass_error=(d.mass_per_area-target)/target
    path=joinpath(out,"dye_history.csv")
    fresh=!isfile(path)
    open(path,"a") do io
        fresh && println(io,"time_s,physical_age_s,dye_mass_per_area,dye_relative_mass_error,dye_centroid_depth_m,dye_z99_depth_m,dye_negative_mass_fraction,dye_min_concentration,dye_max_concentration")
        values=(t,m.config["initial_age"]+t,d.mass_per_area,mass_error,
            d.centroid_depth_m,d.z99_depth_m,d.negative_mass_fraction,d.min_concentration,d.max_concentration)
        println(io,join((@sprintf("%.17g",x) for x in values),','))
    end
    path=joinpath(out,"dye_profiles.csv");fresh=!isfile(path)
    open(path,"a") do io
        fresh && println(io,join(vcat("time_s",["c_"*string(k) for k in eachindex(q.dz)]),','))
        println(io,join((@sprintf("%.17g",x) for x in vcat(t,d.profile)),','))
    end
    write_toml(joinpath(out,"dye_metadata.toml"),Dict(
        "description"=>"Passive wave-averaged concentration advected by native prognostic UL",
        "diffusivity_m2_s"=>m.config["dye_diffusivity"],
        "initial_profile"=>"surface-centred Gaussian exp[-(z/delta)^2], exact cell averages, unit mass per horizontal area",
        "initial_width_m"=>m.config["dye_initial_width"],
        "initial_cells_per_width"=>get(m.config,"dye_initial_cells_per_width",NaN),
        "boundary_conditions"=>"periodic horizontal; impermeable and zero diffusive flux at top and bottom",
        "quantile_definition"=>"positive depth containing 99% of horizontally averaged positive concentration; linear interpolation within each finite-volume cell",
        "centroid_definition"=>"positive depth; signed cell concentration times cell-centre depth divided by signed mass",
        "evolution_clipping"=>false,"mass_renormalization"=>false,
        "advection"=>get(m.config,"dye_advection","conservative_weno5"),"latest_time_s"=>t,
        "face_reconstruction"=>"native WENO5 with conservative positive donor reconstruction; identical shared-face flux; momentum reconstruction unchanged",
        "minimum_buffer_upwind_order"=>get(m.config,"current_minimum_buffer_upwind_order",3),
        "advection_boundary_fallback"=>(get(m.config,"current_minimum_buffer_upwind_order",3)==1 ?

"""Minimal wave sources, in canonical b coordinates.

All Gamma values are ENERGY rates. The corresponding b tendency is Gamma*b/2.
The physical first-order surface is 2Re(sum A exp(ikx-iomega*t)), with
b=sqrt(2omega/k)*A*exp(-iomega*t). Consequently E2/rho=sum(omega*abs2(b))
and the whole-parent-band characteristic slope is sqrt(2sum(k^3/omega*abs2(b))).
No coefficient is fitted to dye. The wind budget limiter is a physical cap,
not another empirical coefficient. All rates use intrinsic GC frequencies.
"""

const WAVE_SOURCE_MODES = ("none", "fixed", "observed", "wind_visc", "wind_damped")

function validate_wave_sources!(cfg)
    cfg["wave_source_mode"] in WAVE_SOURCE_MODES || error("Unknown wave_source_mode")
    for name in ("wind_input_coefficient", "parent_nu", "parent_damping_coefficient", "parent_damping_threshold")
        isfinite(cfg[name]) && cfg[name]>=0 || error("$name must be finite and nonnegative")
    end
    isfinite(cfg["air_water_density_ratio"]) && cfg["air_water_density_ratio"]>0 || error("air_water_density_ratio must be positive")
    isfinite(cfg["water_density"]) && cfg["water_density"]>0 || error("water_density must be positive")
    isfinite(cfg["wave_wind_angle"]) || error("wave_wind_angle must be finite radians")
    iszero(cfg["wave_wind_angle"]) || error("This matched wind-drift benchmark imposes along-x wind; wave_wind_angle must be zero")
    cfg["wave_momentum_exchange"] isa Bool || error("wave_momentum_exchange must be Bool")
    if cfg["wave_source_mode"] == "observed"
        isempty(cfg["observed_steepness_file"]) && error("observed mode requires a two-column TSV")
        raw=readdlm(cfg["observed_steepness_file"], '\t', Float64; skipstart=1)
        size(raw,2)==2 && size(raw,1)>=2 || error("Observed steepness TSV must contain time_s and steepness")
        all(isfinite,raw) && all(diff(raw[:,1]).>0) && all(raw[:,2].>0) || error("Invalid observed steepness series")
        first(raw[:,1]) <= cfg["initial_age"] && last(raw[:,1]) >= cfg["initial_age"]+cfg["duration"]-1e-9 ||
            error("Observed steepness does not cover the simulated physical ages")
        cfg["observed_times"] = collect(raw[:,1])
        cfg["observed_log_slopes"] = log.(raw[:,2])
    end
    return cfg
end

"""Log-linear interpolation: returns target slope and its logarithmic derivative."""
function observed_slope_and_rate(cfg,age)
    ts=cfg["observed_times"]; ys=cfg["observed_log_slopes"]
    age>=first(ts)-1e-8 && age<=last(ts)+1e-8 || error("Observed source age outside available measurements")
    i=clamp(searchsortedlast(ts,age),1,length(ts)-1)
    slope=(ys[i+1]-ys[i])/(ts[i+1]-ts[i])
    return exp(ys[i]+slope*(age-ts[i])),slope
end

function wave_source_coefficients(cfg,kx,ky,omega,bv,elapsed)
    k=hypot.(kx,ky)
    power=abs2.(bv)
    s2=2sum(k.^3 ./ omega .* power)
    steepness=sqrt(max(0.,s2))
    gin=zeros(length(k)); gnu=zero(gin); gpc=zero(gin); gprescribed=zero(gin)
    mode=cfg["wave_source_mode"]
    tau=cfg["wind_alpha"]*sqrt(max(0.,cfg["initial_age"]+elapsed)) # total kinematic stress
    limiter=1.; unclipped_fraction=0.
    if mode in ("wind_visc","wind_damped")
        theta=cfg["wave_wind_angle"]
        direction=max.(0.,(cos(theta).*kx.+sin(theta).*ky)./k)
        # tau/(rho_a/rho_w) equals air friction velocity squared.
        gin .= cfg["wind_input_coefficient"] .* omega .* (tau/cfg["air_water_density_ratio"]) .* (k./omega).^2 .* direction
        inputx=sum(kx.*gin.*power); inputy=sum(ky.*gin.*power)
        requested=hypot(inputx,inputy)
        unclipped_fraction=tau>0 ? requested/tau : 0.
        if requested>tau && requested>0
            limiter=tau/requested
            gin .*= limiter
        end
        gnu .= 4cfg["parent_nu"] .* k.^2
        if mode=="wind_damped"
            gpc .= gnu .* (cfg["parent_damping_coefficient"]*max(steepness-cfg["parent_damping_threshold"],0.)^2)
        end
    elseif mode=="observed"
        _,rate=observed_slope_and_rate(cfg,cfg["initial_age"]+elapsed)
        gprescribed .= 2rate
    end
    gamma=gin.-gnu.-gpc.+gprescribed
    return (;gamma,gin,gnu,gpc,gprescribed,steepness,tau,limiter,unclipped_fraction)
end

function source_state(m)
    kx=2π.*m.mx./m.grid.Lx;ky=2π.*m.my./m.grid.Ly
    bv=m.b[m.locations]
    r=wave_source_coefficients(m.config,kx,ky,m.omega,bv,m.ocean.clock.time)
    db=zero(m.b);db[m.locations] .= 0.5 .* r.gamma .* bv
    return db,r
end

function wave_source_diagnostics(m)
    _,r=source_state(m)
    bv=m.b[m.locations];power=abs2.(bv);kx=2π.*m.mx./m.grid.Lx;ky=2π.*m.my./m.grid.Ly
    rho=m.config["water_density"]
    energy_rate(gamma)=rho*sum(m.omega.*gamma.*power)
    mx_rate(gamma)=rho*sum(kx.*gamma.*power)
    my_rate(gamma)=rho*sum(ky.*gamma.*power)
    U=native_U(m);_,Pp=pseudomomentum(m);q=m.coupling.layers
    ulx=sum(q.dz[k]*mean(view(U[1],:,:,k)) for k in eachindex(q.dz))
    uly=sum(q.dz[k]*mean(view(U[2],:,:,k)) for k in eachindex(q.dz))
    px=sum(q.dz[k]*mean(view(Pp[1],:,:,k)) for k in eachindex(q.dz))
    py=sum(q.dz[k]*mean(view(Pp[2],:,:,k)) for k in eachindex(q.dz))
    return Dict{String,Any}(
        "time_s"=>m.ocean.clock.time,"physical_age_s"=>m.config["initial_age"]+m.ocean.clock.time,
        "parent_characteristic_steepness"=>r.steepness,
        "parent_quadratic_energy_J_m2"=>rho*sum(m.omega.*power),
        "wind_input_W_m2"=>energy_rate(r.gin),"molecular_loss_W_m2"=>energy_rate(r.gnu),
        "extra_parent_loss_W_m2"=>energy_rate(r.gpc),"prescribed_wave_power_W_m2"=>energy_rate(r.gprescribed),
        "wave_wind_stress_x_Pa"=>mx_rate(r.gin),"wave_wind_stress_y_Pa"=>my_rate(r.gin),
        "wave_loss_stress_x_Pa"=>mx_rate(r.gnu.+r.gpc),"wave_loss_stress_y_Pa"=>my_rate(r.gnu.+r.gpc),
        "wave_source_momentum_rate_x_Pa"=>mx_rate(r.gamma),"wave_source_momentum_rate_y_Pa"=>my_rate(r.gamma),
        "supplied_stress_Pa"=>rho*r.tau,"wind_input_limiter"=>r.limiter,
        "unclipped_wave_stress_fraction"=>r.unclipped_fraction,
        "integrated_UL_x_m2_s"=>ulx,"integrated_UL_y_m2_s"=>uly,
        "integrated_UE_x_m2_s"=>ulx-px,"integrated_UE_y_m2_s"=>uly-py,
        "integrated_wave_p_x_m2_s"=>px,"integrated_wave_p_y_m2_s"=>py,
        "max_source_energy_rate_s_inv"=>maximum(abs,r.gamma))
end

function record_wave_sources!(m,out)
    d=wave_source_diagnostics(m)
    path=joinpath(out,"wave_source_history.csv")
    fields=sort!(collect(keys(d)))
    new=!isfile(path)
    open(path,"a") do io
        new && println(io,join(fields,','))
        println(io,join((@sprintf("%.17g",d[name]) for name in fields),','))
    end
    return d
end
